reading: Per bundled object: the licence text its wheel carries (shipped under licenses/<wheel>/), the version-matched official terms, and whether each grants distribution of that object. A reading of licence texts, not a legal conclusion. Each object is checked against its own wheel's file; equal file bytes are not taken to mean equal terms. scripts/native/license_audit.py checks this file and renders shipping/THIRD_PARTY.md from it.

distribution.reading: No public distribution until the owner closes the open items (Phase C scope §4). Engineering verification may proceed.

statuses.grant_in_bundled_and_official: both the shipped text and the version-matched official terms grant distribution of the object
statuses.grant_in_both_texts_differ: both grant distribution of the object, under texts that differ
statuses.grant_in_official_only: the shipped text does not name the object; the version-matched official terms grant its distribution
statuses.no_licence_text_shipped: the package carries no licence text for the object
